title: tincraft [LEGACY]
description: a mod about tech and automation
body:
# tincraft
welcome to tincraft! A mod all about automation and crafting. base crafting ingredients for the mod is tin ingots or tin blocks. 


# resources and blocks
* tin ingot
* tin block
* tin ore
and more later on

# mod developers
currently the api is in the development but it will be published eventually on maven central
## coming soon!!


# note!
This mod isn't complete and is in development

# issues
if you found bugs or want to suggest a feature go to https://github.com/randomusert-s-mods/tincraft/issues
